component.name: Echora
component.summary: Native recompilation of Ocarina of Time for Nintendo Switch 2

description.p: Echora is an experimental native recompilation of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time for Nintendo Switch 2. It translates the game's code ahead of time into native code and runs it on a reimplementation of the console's services. It requires your own legally obtained copy of the game and contains no game files.
